key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Twining or trailing vine with long branches; often prostrate on bare ground or climbing nearby vegetation.

key_traits.label: Root
key_traits.text: Deep taproot with fleshy belowground caudex.

key_traits.label: Stem
key_traits.text: Ridged, tough, essentially glabrous in local material.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate; oblong to narrowly ovate/lanceolate, with hastate or sagittate spreading basal lobes.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: Short, about 3–4.3 mm in Williamson County material.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: Broadly funnel-shaped, about 15–20 mm long and 21–30 mm across; white/cream, sometimes pinkish outside.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Rounded capsule; persistent style base may form a point.
